description: This is a unit test class for testing the behavior of the JsonObjectMerger class, specifically its ability to merge JsonObject instances correctly, including handling nested structures and array merging.

classes.name: MergeJsonObjectsTest
classes.description: A JUnit test class to verify the correctness and immutability of the JsonObjectMerger class.

methods.name: assertImmutability
methods.description: Tests that the JsonObjectMerger class is immutable.

methods.name: emptyObjectsMergeToEmptyObject
methods.description: Verifies that merging two empty JsonObjects results in an empty JsonObject.

methods.name: retainExtraFieldFromObject1
methods.description: Checks that an extra field in object1 is retained after merging with an empty object2.

methods.name: retainExtraFieldFromObject2
methods.description: Checks that an extra field in object2 is retained after merging with an empty object1.

methods.name: mergeFieldsFromBothObjects
methods.description: Verifies that fields from both objects are combined correctly into the merged object.

methods.name: mergeFieldsInsideArrays
methods.description: Tests merging of nested arrays within JSON objects, ensuring nested objects and array elements are merged correctly.
